authentication: none for the manifest and for download.open.fda.gov (static ZIP files)
cost_notes: free; no SLA and no commercial support; FDA may throttle or restrict access per its terms
entity_identifiers: inherits the identifiers of whichever endpoint is exported (510(k) number, PMA number, UDI-DI, product_code, registration number)
historical_coverage: full history per endpoint: device/udi 5,182,695 records in 52 parts; device/event 26,557,775 in 375 parts; device/510k 176,529 in 1 part (238.55 MB); device/pma 57,421 (21.23 MB); device/classification 7,097 (3.13 MB)
known_limitations: export_date is a snapshot/refresh clock for the whole export, not a publication date for any individual record; treating it as per-record publication would date everything to the snapshot day
sizes are hostile to a bounded study: device/510k is one 238.55 MB file and device/udi is 52 parts, so only small partitions (classification, 3.13 MB) were byte-verified in this pass
the manifest publishes sizes and record counts but no checksum, so integrity has to be established locally (we hash what we download)
partitions of one endpoint are not independent datasets; concatenating them without keeping the export_date loses the snapshot identity
licence: public domain: FDA dedicates openFDA content/data to the public domain under a Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal dedication (open.fda.gov/license/, verified)
rate_limits: manifest request obeys the openFDA API limits; the export partitions are served as static files with no documented per-file throttle
research_value: The only route to a reproducible, rate-limit-free snapshot of the US device regulatory corpus: one manifest lists every endpoint's export_date, part count and record count, so a study can pin an exact vintage instead of drifting with a live API. This is what makes a defensible point-in-time backfill possible at all.
timestamp_fields: export_date (per endpoint, in the manifest - a snapshot clock)
each partition's records carry their own event dates (e.g. decision_date, publish_date)
update_frequency: per endpoint; observed export_date 2026-11-02 (510k, pma, classification, registrationlisting), 2026-11-03 (udi), 2026-11-06 (recall)
